title: Keynote - JSON Graph: Reactive REST at Netflix
summary: Jafar Husain's ACM keynote presents Netflix's JSON Graph and Falcor, which let web developers treat all cloud data as one virtual JSON model. It combines reactive programming with REST principles.
why: HN commenters point to it as an alternative take on the data-fetching problem GraphQL addresses, and as a clear argument for when RPC or graph models beat plain REST.

quote.text: gives a very nice summary of when and how you might prefer RPC to REST
